dialogues.speaker: Lila
dialogues.text: *sobs* Grandma, please, since it's the Dendro Archon's birthday, can I not take my medicine...?

dialogues.speaker: Tahmina
dialogues.text: Oh, but the Dendro Archon wants you to be healthy, my little Lila! If you don't take your medicine, how will you get better?

dialogues.speaker: Lila
dialogues.text: O—Okay then... Fine. But can I at least have some candy before I take it?

dialogues.speaker: Tahmina
dialogues.text: My dear Lila, if you have the medicine after the candy, then won't it be the bitter aftertaste that sticks around?

dialogues.speaker: Tahmina
dialogues.text: Even the scariest Eremites know that work comes before play. If you don't believe me... Perhaps I should ask them to teach you?

dialogues.speaker: Lila
dialogues.text: No, no! They're scary! I don't want that...
